# Previous autodev retrospective

Context: an earlier personal automation implementation.

- Orchestration layers, dashboards, and adapters were added before daily use proved they were needed.
- Detailed standing rules helped early, then interfered as Agent Hosts improved.
- Pending chat approvals were easy to forget; approval needs a durable marker bound to reviewed content.
- Decisions without their context, compared options, and observed outcome were difficult to reuse.
